title: AC1027 named-BLOCKS ATTDEF LTYPE XDATA target binding

scope.source: Runtime-generated original ASCII and binary DXF records; no repository drawing fixture was added.
scope.cross_product: One ATTDEF code-1005 target in a named AuthorityBlock BLOCKS record across all four source/output encoding pairs.

xdata.provider: source-bound simple LTYPE EditDash and APPID MLINE_LTYPE_XDATA

proof.source: Candidate indexing requires the physical ATTDEF span and owner, the named-BLOCKS membership row, the paired AttdefSource/addAttDef delivery events, a unique exact DRW_Attdef model equal to the captured pair, and attdefPairReady() for the originating block. The ATTDEF pair's independent source/profile/origin gate is retained; raw/typed pointer identity is not assumed.
proof.output: All four ASCII/binary input/output combinations verify emitted ATTDEF identity, BLOCKS section and remapped block-record owner, selected physical text/tag/prompt/point/height/flag fields, ordered LTYPE code-1005 remapping, and fresh typed ATTDEF/LTYPE readback.
proof.failure_retry: Each encoding pair removes the target and verifies destination preservation followed by same-adapter retry. An additional late handle mutation refuses with destination preservation and succeeds after restoring the target identity.

limits: This qualifies one AC1027 named-BLOCKS ATTDEF source profile only. Standalone ENTITIES ATTDEF targets, other ATTDEF field/subclass/version profiles, and multiple-target combinations remain unqualified.
The selected transport proof does not establish ATTRIB/INSERT attribute association, ATTDEF editing support, recursive dependency closure, complete-document conversion, or independent CAD semantics.
P2 remains open for other code-1005 target types, mixed target sets and broader source/output profiles.
next: Select the next current P2 target with a reproduced indexing or emitted-output gap; keep ENTITIES ATTDEF outside this block-pair implementation until it has its own source and dispatch proof.
